name: node-on-path
label: Node.js
description: node is on the PATH and runnable.

commands.win32: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $arch = if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64') { 'arm64' } else { 'x64' }; $v = (Invoke-RestMethod https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json | ForEach-Object { $_ } | Where-Object { $_.lts } | Select-Object -First 1).version; $root = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Programs'; $dir = Join-Path $root "node-$v-win-$arch"; if (-not (Test-Path (Join-Path $dir 'node.exe'))) { $zip = Join-Path $env:TEMP "node-$v-win-$arch.zip"; Invoke-WebRequest "https://nodejs.org/dist/$v/node-$v-win-$arch.zip" -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing; Expand-Archive $zip $root -Force; Remove-Item $zip -Force }; $user = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable('Path', 'User'); if (-not (("$user" -split ';') | Where-Object { $_ -and ([IO.Path]::GetFullPath($_).TrimEnd('\') -ieq $dir) })) { [Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', ($dir + ';' + $user).TrimEnd(';'), 'User') }

exe_data.prompt: Install Node.js LTS (https://nodejs.org/en/download) on this machine.
